title: 일본ㆍ중국 및 핀란드산 도공(Coated) 인쇄용지에 대한 덤핑방지관세 부과에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 일본ㆍ중국 및 핀란드산 도공(Coated) 인쇄용지에 대한 덤핑방지관세 부과에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 2 (Goods Subject to Duties) Goods subject to anti-dumping duties shall be coated printing paper originating from Japan, China, or Finland, classified under item numbers 4810.13.1000, 4810.14.0000, 4810.19.1000, 4810.19.9000, 4810.22.0000, or 4810.29.0000 of the Harmonized Tariff and Statistical Schedule under Article 98 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Customs Act, with a weight exceeding 55 grams but not exceeding 110 grams per square meter.
